creation_gate.shortest_normal_path: one Opus relationship reviewer reads all model-visible inputs and returns one structured review; root passes it through unchanged
creation_gate.observed_error_path: one supported violation was categorized incorrectly while two unsupported rule identities were admitted as separate findings
creation_gate.existing_boundary_insufficient: the base prompt requires a catalog rule identity and high confidence but does not require exact catalog membership, contract-based category selection, or deduplication before admission
creation_gate.replaced_predicate: admit a finding only when its rule identity exists in the catalog and its category and complete path set consistently identify one verified violation
creation_gate.removed_decision_points: inventing a rule identity, selecting category from authority location, and splitting one violation into multiple findings
creation_gate.new_decision_points: one final consistency check over category, rule identity, and the complete changed-path set
creation_gate.quality_check: PRR-C02/r2 development benchmark against the saved Opus result; quality score remains a KPI without a pass threshold
creation_gate.stop_condition: stop after the fixed C02 repetition if measurement is incomplete; do not claim held-out effect or generalization from this case

fixed: root does not access fixture tool or reassess findings
same model-visible inputs, permissions, review contract, and output schema
same rating and three KPI measurement
non_goals: case-specific expected answer or path hint
generalization, winner, adoption, release, or runtime projection
